03413 Y@remay {yer-ay-mah'-ee}

源自 07311 "被升高"; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Jeremai 1; 1

耶利買 = "我的高昇"
1) 哈順的後裔之一, 他曾娶了一外邦女子為妻, 因以斯拉的要求而被迫離婚 (#拉 10:33|)

from 07311 elevated;; n pr m

AV - Jeremai 1; 1

Jeremai = "my exaltations"
1) a descendant of Hashum who took a foreign wife in the time of
   Ezra and was compelled to put her away
